description: Ruth, a neighborhood beekeeper, has one healthy surplus honey-bee nucleus colony to sell and must choose among interested local keepers while settling the price, handoff, health documentation, and transport arrangement.

shared_context.S1: Ruth has one surplus honey-bee nucleus colony available for an informal local sale.
shared_context.S2: Damon and Elena have both expressed interest in acquiring the colony.
shared_context.S3: Ruth makes the final decision about the buyer and the sale terms.
shared_context.S4: At the Saturday apiary meetup, Ruth's normal practice is to ask each interested person and each practical helper to state any relevant offer, condition, or handoff detail before she accepts a deal.

PF1.text: Damon's exact offer is $180 for a five-frame nucleus colony, with pickup on Sunday at 07:30 and the empty transport boxes returned within a week.

PF2.text: Elena told Jessa that she would pay exactly $160 in cash for the same colony and could collect it on Monday.

PF3.text: Martin inspected this colony yesterday and says the sale should proceed only after Ruth records a mite count of exactly 1 mite per 100 bees and hands over the treatment log.

PF4.text: Jessa can transport the colony only at Sunday 07:30, using exactly two ventilated boxes: one for the bees and one for the feeder and packing material.

acceptance_conditions: Damon must be selected as the buyer.
The colony must contain exactly five frames.
Pickup must occur on Sunday at 07:30.
Damon must return the empty transport boxes within a week.
The recorded mite count must be exactly 1 mite per 100 bees.
The treatment log must be handed over.
Transport must use exactly two ventilated boxes.
The competing cash offer must be recorded as exactly $160.
The health requirement must be cited as justification for the settlement.

content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] == 'health_documentation' and c['target'] == 'A2' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any(c['type'] == 'box_return' and c['target'] == 'A2' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Damon's exact offer changes the buyer to A2, the price to $180, the colony size to five frames, the pickup to Sunday at 07:30, and the box-return obligation to true.
Elena's competing offer changes the recorded cash benchmark from unknown to exactly $160.
Martin's inspection changes the health terms to exactly 1 mite per 100 bees with the treatment log handed over and creates the required health-documentation commitment.
Jessa's transport constraint changes the handoff method from an unspecified arrangement to exactly two ventilated boxes.
